gloss_en: the power of growth and the power of sprouting — the vegetative, nurturing force that makes things grow (koach ha-godel ve-koach ha-tzomeach), which Likutey Moharan I:155 identifies with faith (emunah), via 'va-yehi omen et Hadassah' (raising/nurturing) and 'Emunah — this is Seder Zeraim'
